question.prompt: The universal set has 8 elements, \(A\) has 5 elements, \(B\) has 4 elements, and \(A\cap B\) has 2 elements. How many elements are in the complement of \(A\cup B\) in the universal set?

solutions.explanation: The union has \(5+4-2=7\) elements. The complement is obtained by removing the union from the universal set, so \(8-7=1\).
solutions.title: Union followed by complement
